title: Wayfarer
description: A named adventurer the Wayfarer Chest can call to the Lantern Inn (03-GAME-DESIGN §10.4, D-091): a hero in every way once called. One file per wayfarer under content/wayfarers/<id>.json; the cast list is owned by docs/04-CLASSES.md §7 and written by tools/content/gen-wayfarers.ts.

grade.description: Sets the draw odds and the creation points: 6 + 1 per grade above D.

freePoints.description: Creation points by attribute, 1–3 each (03 §2.3); the total is 6 + 1 per grade above D (rule 34).

starterSkillIds.description: Three Tier I skills of the class, at least one active (rule 34).

aiRule.description: Their own AI rule (the grammar of sim/src/ai.ts); null for the class's default rule.
